peziculoid.translation: 具无柄盘菌亚科特性的

peziza.definition:
n. A genus of fungi embracing a great number of species, some
   of which are remarkable for their regular cuplike form and deep colors.

pezizales.definition: n. order of mostly saprophytic fungi having cup-shaped ascocarps

pezizoid.definition:
a. Resembling a fungus of the genus Peziza; having a cuplike
   form.

pezophaps solitaria.translation: [网络] 罗德里格斯渡渡鸟
